common.sourcePremise: OriginalCosmologyP319 offers these arcs to campaigns continuing beyond its epilogue. P320–322 supply the three hooks. The current owner campaign-frame answer remains pending.
common.placement: Each arc has one persistent moduleInstanceId. Before activation record its compatible post-epilogue campaign frame, actual local map links, start timestamp and named participants. Do not silently activate it in the current campaign. A separately agreed alternate staging must label every chronology change NEW. These drafts choose no AE year or numbered Dungeon floor.
common.authority: Original manuscripts and explicit owner corrections govern lore. All new NPCs, sites, numbers, vehicles, procedures and handouts in this draft are proposed adaptation authorship. No Builder/Ul’nak/OldGod/survivor/Q6 identity merge or Equation recovery follows.
common.clock: Campaign time is continuous. Actions take6seconds when tracked outside initiative; turns/rounds use actual regular-slot rules. Core task degrees/natural shifts apply; a binary task collapses both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure. Saves remain binary. Rests, source exhaustion/Wounds, actual resource costs, travel and carrying limits remain current.
common.stock: All stock is attached to the one module instance and its actual owners. Destroyed, consumed, stolen or removed stock stays so. Re-entry, replay, new session or renamed party never replenishes it. Ordinary replacement requires an actual source and a separately recorded transaction.
common.tuning: NEW illustrative four-level11-character encounter tuning only. No assertion of balanced difficulty, actual party composition, runtime support or human playtest. Preserve normal withdrawal and separately acquired abilities.
common.knowledge: These arcs reveal only their stated local facts. Material evidence may support ordinary relevant investigation; it is not automatically a research qualification mark, Equation fragment, spell, feat or class feature.
common.safety: Players may summarize character fiction or use an agreed neutral surrogate. No real private disclosure, compulsory roleplay performance or forced belief. Failed/declined tasks retain concrete alternatives below.

arcs.title: Rekindling Stars
arcs.status: LOCAL NEW PROVISIONAL AUTHORSHIP — not submitted to GPT, not adopted, not playtested.
arcs.hook: One of the new constellations above post-epilogue Yieldheart dims nightly. Three finite stray Null fragments in local instruments redirect its light into soundless weapons.
arcs.startAndDeadline: At activation record the actual chosen Equinox dawn timestamp E and start at E−72hours for this NEW scenario. This relative interval does not assign an AE year, civil month or recovered astronomical date. Tell players E before commitment. A fragment sealed exactly at E counts before the dawn outcome; later sealing cannot reverse that completed outcome.

map.hub: NEW public Lantern Court in the source’s post-epilogue surface Yieldheart; not the similarly named Dungeon tier.30x30ft level open plaza, three10ft ordinary street exits.

sites.name: North Observatory
sites.route: One actual known0.5mile street from court;10min at3mph before actual pace modifiers.
sites.geometry: 30x20ft room,10ft door in south wall, six5ft floor squares to the northern instrument bench. One ordinary10ft stair leads to a flat30x20ft roof with3ft parapet; stairs remain a physical exit.
sites.visible: A cracked three-ring lens points at a star chart. Plaque: OPEN THE VENT BEFORE TURNING THE INNER RING. A10ft-radius zone around lens prevents sound production/transmission, including audible verbal spell components, but does not cancel effects already running. Leaving its radius restores sound immediately.
sites.actors: Two ARC-HUSH-DRONEs at the bench; hostile only when a creature touches the lens or attacks a spindle. Each has its own38HP.
sites.solution: One Action within5ft opens labeled vent; next Action rotates inner ring and powers off both extant spindles. No roll if this sequence is followed; manipulating inner ring first deals2d6force to the operator, warns visibly, then leaves state unchanged. Other legal methods use real damage/abilities.
sites.fragment: One silver sliver0.1lb in an ordinary glass sleeve; one Action to remove after power is off or both spindles destroyed. A fragment carries no portable silence zone or damage ability.
sites.clue: Printed chart links its pulse to the two other sites and identifies all three matching serialsS1/S2/S3; copying requires1minute, no roll.

sites.name: River Bell House
sites.geometry: 20x20ft ground room with5ft west door and ordinary stairs to a20x20ft bell loft10ft above. A bolted safety line runs beside the intact stair; no compulsory jump.
sites.visible: Three marked counterweights read1,2,3. A notice says: SUPPORT3, RELEASE1, THEN LIFT2. The bell is silent; the chain visibly strikes loose stone each minute while running.
sites.solution: Three Actions at the loft control in the displayed sequence stop the mechanism. Wrong sequence causes the next minute pulse once: creatures in loft DEXsaveDC14, failure2d6bludgeoning, successhalf; no pulse while outside loft. Then reset lever positions, no resource reset. One Action to engage the labeled brake stops pulses for10minutes, allowing normal examination; brake can be reused but does not remove the fragment itself.
sites.fragment: One black sliver0.1lb; one Action after stopping sequence. The fragment’s local mechanism ceases permanently once removed.
sites.clue: Maintenance log explicitly confirms fragments moved into instruments after the constellation first dimmed. It names no cosmic identity or Equation.

sites.name: West Glass Garden
sites.geometry: 30x30ft enclosed courtyard,10ft east gate unlocked, raised circular planter10ft diameter in centre and a5ft walkway around it.
sites.visible: One floating sliver inside a visible glass cage. Three wall shutters markedSHADE/REFLECT/OPEN. Posted gardener note: SHADE RELEASES THE LATCH.
sites.actors: One ARC-HUSH-DRONE beside cage; attacks only if cage is struck or opened while reflector shines.
sites.solution: One Action at wall selectsSHADE; one Action at cage opens it. No roll. If reflective light remains, opening requires DEX(Thieves tools)DC15, Action, applicable actual proficiency only; failure does not open and alerts spindle. SelectingSHADE subsequently powers it off. Destroying cageAC12HP15 is another real option but causes3d6force to creatureswithin5ft,DEX14half, once.
sites.fragment: One pale sliver0.1lb. Removing it ends cage hazard and powers off any surviving spindle; damaged cage never reforms.
sites.clue: Gardener’s rubbing depicts the same three serials; the source is local installed equipment, not proof of where Null originated.

map.return: Every site returns by its ordinary street. No automatic movement or floor access.

containment.site: Lantern Court bench: three keyed socketsS1/S2/S3, one crank, one shutter. Its one physical housing50lb is bolted to actual plaza stone.
containment.stock: One housing, three reusable sockets, six sealed insulator pads0.1lb each, one mundane wrench. Nothing respawns.
containment.procedure: Fit each actual fragment to its matching socket, one Action each. Close shutter, one Action. Turn crank for10uninterrupted active minutes: this is a fixed observation/stabilization interval, not crafting or casting, so Transition does not halve it. No check. Interrupting releases no blast; begin the10minutes again with fragments still present. At completion all installed fragments become inert sealed salvage; no charges, spell or research mark.
containment.incomplete: Housing accepts1–3fragments; a completed cycle seals those present. Later additions need another10minute cycle. Installed but unfinished fragments are not sealed at deadline. Removing an inert sealed fragment is ordinary10minute tool work and does not reactivate it.

outcomes.three: At E, all3sealed: constellation returns that night; local weapons stay disabled.
outcomes.oneOrTwo: At E, only1–2sealed: constellation remains dim for40days, then recovers naturally. Each unsealed site emits its stated local hazard until ordinary recovery shuts it down. No new citywide condition or hidden damage.
outcomes.zero: At E,0sealed: constellation darkens forone400dayAethelcivil year; local hazards remain as above. This does not destroy a god, plane, identity or star in another campaign frame.
outcomes.late: Later recovery still disables remaining local hazards and prevents injury; it cannot erase already elapsed darkness.
outcomes.reward: NEW municipal offer posted at start:50gp per actual fragment sealed and physically surrendered at court, maximum150gp total from escrow. Each serial paid once, even if unsealed before payment or traded. A30lb empty chest holds exactly150gp; keeper releases only earned sums. No title, feat, class level or free relic.

arcs.playerHandout: Three serials, three sites: North Observatory, River Bell House, West Glass Garden. Return the matching slivers to Lantern Court. Equinox dawn is the stated deadline. The posted offer pays50gp for each safely sealed sliver, once. The nearby mechanisms have visible service instructions; force is one choice, not the only route.

arcs.title: Conclave of Untitled Songs
arcs.status: LOCAL NEW PROVISIONAL AUTHORSHIP — not submitted to GPT, not adopted, not playtested.
arcs.hook: Bards across Aethel begin forgetting melodies at random, as in the original hook. Three local musicians at the Conclave give the party concrete evidence of the widespread problem. An errant equation echoes from a Broken Ladder strand in the upper atmosphere and produces the interference, preserving the original cause. This local errant equation is not the lost original cosmic Equation or a granted research qualification. This is conditional post-epilogue staging, not a declaration that the current campaign has already reached that era.
arcs.investigation: At the NEW Conclave Hall, a30x30ft meeting room with two10ft ground exits, the three witnesses and their actual scores are available by appointment during a recorded8hour daytime period. Comparing the three affected scores for20active minutes with INT(Investigation)DC15, or hearing all three witnesses explain their records for30minutes without a roll, identifies repeated sequence3–1–4 and the recorded strand bearing. Failure gives no false location and permits the longer interview. The witnesses also show dated letters from two actually named distant music schools reporting the same phenomenon; these are local evidence of geographic scope, not a complete world census. Reading these scores grants no Choir motif or Bard technique.
arcs.access: The Conclave owns exactly one NEW sky-vessel, Margin Kite, and offers one expedition to retrieve the strand. Two named hired crew NimaVoss/PellRusk use ARC-CREW profiles and may refuse a knowingly overloaded/unserviceable departure. The Conclave pays their20gp total expedition wage from a finite40gp crew escrow; a second sortie needs the remaining20gp and actual remaining fuel/air. Players receive no ownership merely by accepting transport.

At each complete unprotected minute CONsaveDC15: failure3d6cold plusone coreExhaustion, successhalfcold and noExhaustion. This is a fantasy local encounter hazard, not real atmospheric simulation. It does not impose a second unnamed suffocation track. Telegraphed before departure. The printed cold damage represents harmful inhalation of this anomalous upper-atmosphere air. An actual no-breath trait therefore exempts this complete local inhalation hazard; it does not confer immunity to separate ordinary or magical external cold. The draft still requires comparison against actual ancestry/class environmental adaptations before joint adoption.

A new crossing fromabove60 to60orless breaks it again; continued damage while already≤60 does not repeatedly undo a repair unless a single hitdeals20or more post-defense hull damage. Stock4patchpads aboard. Hullat0 loses allpowered movement and airseal; no HP or stock restoration by repair ritual without real work.

The first controlled descent step occurs6elapsed seconds later, then every6seconds:300ft down, stopping at actual supporting ground. These are fixed absolute deadlines; initiative changes, extra turns and new pilots do not add or rebase steps. No fuel or engineer contribution is needed. A pilotAction may set up to30ft of legal lateral displacement for the next pending step; later steering Actions replace that setting, never add another movement event. strandScene.procedure: The fixed on-site sequence has three phases. Phase1 is20elapsed minutes of local lattice alignment, beginning on arrival at the marked mooring point. During that interval the pilot and engineer must complete the mooring Actions, and a character must set dial order3-1-4 withthree Actions. A character without the score can spend30active minutes on INT(Investigation)DC15 to derive the order; failure gives no false answer and permits an actual retry. A wrong order causesone3d6psychic pulse to creatureswithin10ft,WIS15half, then resets the dials and invalidates that alignment interval. Phase2, only after successful alignment, uses one actual tooluser and allthree clamps for10active minutes. Phase3 uses actual insulatedtongs and one worker for30active minutes to release the strand and place it in the real linedcase. Phase2/3 are proposed NEW complexsalvagework eligibility forTransition, requiring joint review; no change to the currently adopted module is asserted. Their prerequisites persist throughout actual work. InterruptedPhase2 loses its incomplete phase; interruptedPhase3 retains only completed10minute blocks. With correct supplied order and no interruption, phases20+10+30 total60minutes, including the mooring/dial Actions inPhase1. Actual optional preparation, failed study and interruption add real time.

Plan actual weight, crew, protection and fuel before departure. Ordinary class abilities remain yours.

melodyLoss.sourceAndNew: Widespread random forgetting is preserved from originalP321. The following finite record, cadence and recovery procedure is NEW authorship for review.
melodyLoss.scope: The phenomenon affects bards across Aethel, including eligible people encountered outside the three initial witnesses. Track the actual characters encountered in play; the Director need not fabricate a complete world population or grant unseen losses as research evidence. It is not restricted to the Bard class if an established NPC is a professional bard in the fiction.
melodyLoss.record: Before a tracked bard’s first roll, record at least one actually established mundane melody they know and any surviving written or recorded copies. Do not invent additional forgotten melodies, class techniques or lost memories as a reward for repeated checks. The three initial musicians each have a fixed four-tune repertoire recorded below.
melodyLoss.cadence: At the first recorded local sunset after module activation, then every24elapsed hours for that bard while the strand is attached, choose uniformly among that bard’s currently remembered recorded mundane melodies. Use a die with enough equally likely faces and reroll out-of-range values; never choose a favored result after rolling. With no eligible remembered melody, no additional loss occurs. Record the exact tune and event timestamp; changed location, new session or repeated introduction never adds another event.
melodyLoss.effect: The bard cannot reproduce that particular tune from memory. They retain class cards, spell repertoire, language, instrument skill, unrelated memories and agency. They can follow an actual legible score or playable recording with the ordinary access and sensory requirements. This grants no translation or ability to hear in silence.
melodyLoss.relearning: Ten uninterrupted active minutes studying an actual surviving score or hearing an actual knowledgeable willing teacher restores one named mundane melody, no check. This is training and is not halved byTransition. A later scheduled loss can select it again; the10minutes do not move the next event timestamp. With no surviving source, the specific tune remains forgotten until an actual source is found.
melodyLoss.playerParticipation: Respect the actual session-zero agreement on memory themes. A player can use abstract labels such as TuneA instead of describing an emotionally significant song. If that theme is excluded, keep its consequences on the widespread NPC phenomenon and use an agreed neutral witness role for that PC; do not erase actual class powers to enforce participation.

arcs.status: LOCAL NEW PROVISIONAL AUTHORSHIP — not submitted to GPT, not adopted, not playtested.

Term and bond: informed signature or an understood witnessed mark on this exact document, together with deposit of50gp in actual coins, begins the term at timestampT0. Without the actual deposit no term begins. The first contradiction is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days, the next atT0+800days, and so on while the term continues. Delivery: submit one fictional contradiction for each annual record by placing its written statement in the public quartz-panel slot or dictating it to Veyr at an actual public meeting. Identify two mutually incompatible claims, one actual observed record supporting each, and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Acknowledge known uncertainty honestly; fabricated evidence does not qualify. A previously accepted identical pair of claims and evidence cannot pay another year. Materially new conflicting evidence can support a new submission, with the changed record identified. No real-player secret or belief is required.

Review and grace: the slot retains the actual paper in a visible accessible drawer. Within24elapsed hours of an available issuer receiving it, Veyr gives a numbered written receipt identifying the annual record and the three required fields. A timely submission remains provisionally timely during review. Rejection must name the absent or nonconflicting field. The claimant has10days from actual notice to correct it; a valid correction completed exactly at that deadline resolves before termination. Accepted correction satisfies only its identified annual record. Delayed review or grace never rebases later annual due dates. If more than one annual record is outstanding, each needs its own qualifying submission; one physical delivery may contain several statements.

Examples: one actual record says a sealed chamber was empty atnoon; another shows a named witness inside atnoon; the question asks whether either clock was misread. Or one actual published proof says all accepted gate keys are iron and also records an accepted glass key; the question asks which premise fails. Rain on one day and sun on another do not conflict. The examples teach the form; they are not fabricated observed records the claimant can submit unchanged.

Departure: the claimant may end future participation by an understood declaration to Veyr or a signed statement in the panel. If the current annual record has already been accepted and no earlier record remains unsatisfied, return the actual50gp bond and end the term. Otherwise the claimant may first satisfy those records, or choose immediate exit by forfeiting that50gp bond. This is the entire exit cost. The finite patent title and demonstration permission end; the retained paper copy, learned information, soul, memories, hitpoints, class abilities and unrelated property are not erased or taken.

Default: an unsatisfied annual record after its printed due/grace interval ends the term, forfeits the actual50gp bond and ends the limited title and bench permission. This is the complete default consequence. No additional curse, compulsory mission, death, unbounded debt or automatic Paladin Oath breach is created. These consequences must be disclosed before signature.

Refusal: no term begins. Veyr may offer the separate free-will exercise, which may also be declined. Silence, coercion, incapacity, deception about these terms or another person’s signature cannot create informed acceptance. The claimant may negotiate a different complete written offer before signing; no change is assumed accepted.

Amendment: a new clause requires the claimant’s informed agreement to a complete visible revised document before it takes effect. Veyr cannot change a running deadline retrospectively. The old and new documents remain recorded.

Unavailable issuer: destruction of the panel does not destroy already written records or cancel an obligation; the claimant can arrange actual public delivery to Veyr. When the issuer is unavailable through a due date, a timely documented delivery attempt with the real statement retained gives10days after actual renewed availability to deliver that record. Each later annual record is tracked separately if the absence spans another due date. No extra cold cells, bench charges or duplicate patent copies appear during the absence.
